### OneSearch — Oikos USA (v5)

**Batch + ARRAYFORMULA architecture (Apr 2026):**
1. Trigger → Source Config → 4 reads → 4 norms
   SE filtered: position 1–50 only (Lever 1)
2. Norm GSC + SQR → Merge → Format → Write Base
3. Sync SE → Build: Trigram Index (once)
4. Distribute: SE Rows → Split: SE Batches (500/batch)
   [loop] Match: SE Batch → Update SE Batch (per batch)
   [done] Write: Cost SEO Formulas (ARRAYFORMULA AI+AK)
5. Sync KS → Match: KS Keywords (reuses index)
   ≥0.65 → Update KS cols · else → KW Review
6. KW Review → Wait → Resume → Process → Update

⚠️ Clear rows 2+ in Listing before re-running

### Lever 1 — SE Position Filter
Norm: SE Ranking keeps only rows where
se_position > 0 AND se_position ≤ 50.
Eliminates ~80–90% of SE rows before matching,
fixing the runner crash in Match: SE Keywords.

### Build: Trigram Index
Builds n=3 index on ~1,240 Masterlist col B rows.
Includes uDisplay (keyword display text) — batch nodes
don't need to reload unified data.
Outputs ONE item: {uKeys, uDisplay, uTg, idx}.

### SE Batch Loop
Split: SE Batches chunks filtered SE rows (≤500 each).
Each batch: Match: SE Batch reads index by node name
(no rebuild) and processes only $input (500 rows max).
Update: Masterlist — SE Batch writes per batch.
Last batch's match wins if multiple batches match
the same Masterlist row (rare after position filter).

### Write: Cost SEO Formulas (Lever 2)
Fires from Split: SE Batches done output —
after ALL batches complete.
Writes ARRAYFORMULA to Masterlist sheet:
  AI2 = ARRAYFORMULA(IF(ISBLANK(AF2:AF),"",AF2:AF*P2:P))
  AK2 = ARRAYFORMULA(IF(ISBLANK(AF2:AF),"",AF2:AF*R2:R))
AI = Cost SEO Q1 2026 · AK = Cost SEO Q4 2025

### Match: KS Keywords
Reads index via $('Build: Trigram Index').first().json.
No rebuild — index built once and reused.
Iterates 14,273 KS keywords.
≥ 0.65 → Update KS cols (auto)
0.50–0.65 · <0.50 → KW Review (human)
Fills: A C D E H I AM–AX AZ–BE

### Human-in-the-loop
1. Borderline + unmatched → KW Review tab
2. Workflow pauses — find Resume URL in execution log
3. Open KW Review · type YES in 'approved'
   Optionally fill 'manual_ks_match'
4. POST to webhook or click Resume in n8n UI
5. Approved rows computed + Masterlist updated
